day_local: Xuska Quduusiinta John de Brébeuf, Isaac Jogues, iyo Saxiibadooda, Shuhadada
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Masiixow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiga ayaa inoo abuuray, annaguna waxaan nahay dadkiisa.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuustu ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arkeysaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay diyaarad yar oo uu Ben ku ciyaari jiray, ama buug uu dhigay miiska, ama xataa xusuusta qosolkiisa markuu ka hadlayo 'con chim airlines'. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta. Waxaan maanta dooraneynaa hal sawir oo nala socda: waa sawirka 'qorshaha Ilaah' ee aan ku aragno akhriska koowaad. Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'For we are his handiwork, created in Christ Jesus for good works that God has prepared in advance.' (Anaga waxaan nahay shaqadiisa gacantiisa, oo lagu abuuray Masiixa Ciise si aan u samayno shuqullo wanaagsan oo Ilaah horay u diyaariyey). Bal ka feker sawirkaas. Ilaah wuxuu inoo diyaariyey shuqullo wanaagsan ka hor intaanan xataa dhalan. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil shaqadaas Ilaah si qurux badan u fuliyey. Wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u fiiqan, oo yaqaanay sida loo darsado AWS environments, ama sida loo qoro koodhka GitHub, laakiin wuxuu kaloo ahaa wiil arkayay waxa dadka kale aysan arag: baahida dadka kale iyo jacaylka qoyskiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu barto diyaaradaha, isagoo maskaxdiisa ku dhisayay shirkad uu u bixiyay 'con chim airlines', halkaas oo uu ka qosli jiray oo uu si farxad leh uga sheekeyn jiray. 

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka weyn ee maanta halkan yaalla. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo qoto dheer oo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira saacado marka qorraxdu dhacdo ama marka gurigu aamuso, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara cisrigaas banaanka ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Wuxuu arkaa oohintiinna, wuxuu arkaa dadaalkiinna, wuxuu arkaa jacaylka aad weli u hayso Ben. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Take care to guard against all greed, for though one may be rich, one’s life does not consist of possessions.' (Iska jira damaca oo dhan, waayo inkastoo qofku hodan noqon karo, noloshiisu kama koobna hantida.) Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil fahmay sirtaan. Xusuusnow sida uu u rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado xornimada Masiixa. Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'But God, who is rich in mercy, because of the great love he had for us, brought us to life with Christ.' (Laakiin Ilaah, oo hodan ku ah naxariista, jacaylkiisa weyn ee uu inoo qabo darteed, wuxuu inoo soo nooleeyey Masiixa.) Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil loo doortay inuu iftiimiyo adduunkan. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in shuqullada wanaagsan ee Ilaah uu Ben u diyaariyey ay weli sii socdaan. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jecelahay wax kasta, waxaana rabaa inaan kugu qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin Sacrament-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey ii jooga, waxaana ku weydiisanayaa inaad igu xirto naftaada. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii ka horreeyey ee dhintay, ha ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, Ilaah ha u muujiyo naxariistiisa, ha u qaboojiyo qalbiyadooda, oo ha siiyo rajo aan dhammaanayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Waxaad ahaydeen kuwo dhintay xadgudubyadiinna iyo dembiyadiinna, kuwaas oo aad mar ku dhex noolayd adigoo raacaya da'da dunidan, adigoo raacaya taliyaha awoodda hawada, ruuxa hadda ka shaqeeya kuwa aan addeecin. Dhammaanteen mar ayaan dhexdeena ku noolayn damacyada jidhkeenna, annagoo raacayna rabitaanka jidhka iyo dareenka, waxaana dabiici ahaan ahayn carruur xanaaqsan, sida kuwa kale. Laakiin Ilaah, oo hodan ku ah naxariista, jacaylkiisa weyn ee uu inoo qabo darteed, xataa markaan dhintay xadgudubyadii, wuxuu inoo soo nooleeyey Masiixa (nimco ayaad ku badbaaddeen), wuxuu inoo kiciyey isaga, wuxuuna inoo fadhiisiyey isaga samada dhexdeeda Masiixa Ciise, si uu qarniyada soo socda u muujiyo hodantinimada nimcadiisa ee naxariistiisa aan la qiyaasi karin ee Masiixa Ciise. Waayo nimco ayaad ku badbaaddeen rumaysadka, tanina ma aha idinka; waa hadiyadda Ilaah; ma aha shuqullo, si aan cidina ugu faanin. Waayo waxaan nahay shaqadiisa, oo lagu abuuray Masiixa Ciise shuqullo wanaagsan oo Ilaah horay u diyaariyey, si aan ugu dhex noolaanno.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. (3b) Rabbiga ayaa inoo abuuray, annaguna waxaan nahay dadkiisa. Si farxad leh ugu gabya Rabbiga dhammaantiin dadyow; Rabbiga ugu adeega farxad; hortiisa u imow hees farxad leh. R. Rabbiga ayaa inoo abuuray, annaguna waxaan nahay dadkiisa. Ogaada in Rabbigu yahay Ilaah; isaga ayaa inoo abuuray, annaguna waxaan nahay dadkiisa, adhiga uu daaqiyo. R. Rabbiga ayaa inoo abuuray, annaguna waxaan nahay dadkiisa. Giraamihiisa u soo gala mahadnaq, barxadihiisa u soo gala ammaan. R. Rabbiga ayaa inoo abuuray, annaguna waxaan nahay dadkiisa. Mahadnaqa isaga; magaciisa barakeeya, waayo isagu waa wanaagsan yahay: Rabbiga, oo naxariistiisu weligeed raagto, iyo aaminnimadiisa, ilaa qarniyada oo dhan. R. Rabbiga ayaa inoo abuuray, annaguna waxaan nahay dadkiisa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Qof dadkii badnaa ka mid ah ayaa ku yidhi Ciise, “Macallimow, walaalkay u sheeg inuu dhaxalka ila qaybsado.” Wuxuu ugu jawaabay, “Saaxiibow, yaa ii magacaabay garsoore iyo dhexdhexaadiye dhaxalkaaga?” Markaasuu dadkii badnaa ku yidhi, “Iska jira damaca oo dhan, waayo inkastoo qofku hodan noqon karo, noloshiisu kama koobna hantida.” Markaasuu masaal u sheegay. “Waxaa jiray nin hodan ah oo dhulkiisu soo saaray dalag badan. Wuxuu isweydiiyey, ‘Maxaan samaynayaa, waayo ma haysto meel aan ku kaydiyo dalagga?’ Markaasuu yidhi, ‘Waa tan waxaan samayn doono: Waxaan dumin doonaa bakhaaradayda, waxaana dhisi doonaa kuwo ka waaweyn. Halkaas ayaan ku kaydin doonaa hadhuudhkayga iyo alaabtayda kale, waxaana naftayda ku odhan doonaa, “Hadda adigu, waxaad haysataa waxyaalo badan oo sanado badan kuu kaydsan, naso, cun, cab, oo farax!”’ Laakiin Ilaah wuxuu ku yidhi, ‘Doqon yahow, caawa naftaada ayaa lagaa dalban doonaa; oo waxyaalihii aad diyaarsatay, yaa iska leh?’ Sidaasay u ahaan doontaa qofka naftiisa u kaydiya hanti, laakiin aan hodan ku ahayn waxa Ilaah u qiimo badan.”

day: Memorial of Saints John de Brébeuf and Isaac Jogues, Priests, and Companions, Martyrs

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
